protocol.selection: minimum frozen full-development bpc over fixed passes
protocol.head_channels: independent Q/K/V per head; separate timestamped channels; learned next-block projection
protocol.retained_cache: all per-position head entries; lossless packed slabs; no eviction or compression
protocol.eligibility: one saved detached normalized feature per historical write; key credit factorized across admitted old candidates; winner-only old value credit; 50% extra K/V tensor payload; no past feature/receiver graph credit
protocol.gradient_scope: fixed-feature common historical write-map perturbation transported to current maps; delayed local surrogate with stale weight versions, not full-sequence exact gradient
protocol.learning: per-credit-chunk backward and detach; target-weighted accumulated gradients; once-per-window normalization, clipping and Adam; all admitted counterfactual values charged
protocol.timing: max parallel head arrival; analytic stored-channel evolution; depth*.022 <.5
protocol.scope: Exploratory full-architecture development comparison; CPU serial emulator, not hardware joules
